name: with-select-every-item-draws-its-own-link
description: With the ground's `select` (4.5) each item is a forward of a reply that names no `to`, so each draws its own link: with seed 35 the three items take words 1, 2 and 3 (u = 0.0075.., 0.5055.., 0.7220.., as ground/select-draw-follows-the-seed has them for three replies) and go to b1, b2 and b3. One draw for the whole answer would send all three to b1.
